title: Contextual place
idea: Contextual place: A real setting occupies the main field, with location, access and next action in a grounded side column.
audience: People who need to choose place within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Place and surroundings materially change the visitor decision.
avoidWhen: Stock scenery would impersonate the actual venue.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic environment layout through its choose place priority and explicit commitment contract: Confirm the location and real access restrictions before requesting directions or booking.
navigation: Contextual place keeps the current choose place context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A real setting occupies the main field, with location, access and next action in a grounded side column.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to choose place; place and surroundings materially change the visitor decision.
composition.priority: Confirm the location and real access restrictions before requesting directions or booking.

imagery.role: Support the actual choose place context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Recrop around the meaningful location and bring access details above secondary images.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the contextual place structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no choose place content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Confirm the location and real access restrictions before requesting directions or booking.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized choose place content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Confirm the location and real access restrictions before requesting directions or booking.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active choose place context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
